title: Canonical watchdog must cap missing Required CI dispatches instead of creating runner stampedes
root_cause: Actual production watchdog run #39814141663 emitted 19 REQUIRED_GATE_WATCHDOG_DISPATCHED events in one five-minute tick because missing-gate dispatches were uncapped and recently touched retired PRs were still eligible.
impact: Avoidable workflow fanout increases GitHub runner queue pressure, provider API load, and time to useful BRAIN/Required verification.
failed_approaches: Unbounded redispatch across all open PRs
Treating old retired PR updated_at as proof of active work
Turning off the canonical watchdog to escape pressure
fix: Preserve existing five-minute watchdog and owner handoff while capping new missing-Required dispatches to two per tick and excluding explicitly retired/released/terminal PRs. Keep full source-owner scan; do not introduce scheduler or queue.
prevention_rule: At most two new missing Required dispatches per watchdog tick, never dispatch retired/released/terminal obligations; keep failed owner recovery signals independently budgeted, and verify an actual production watchdog run.
outcome: CANDIDATE bounded dispatch and retired-writer exclusion; verify exact-head gates and production provider readback
